title: Perfect 10 Magazine August 2000 Special Collectors Edition Gena Lee Nolin
descriptionText: The Perfect 10 Magazine August 2000 Special Collectors Edition featuring Gena Lee Nolin offers readers a rare and exclusive look at the popular model. This special edition publication, with its unique content and special features, makes it a must-have for fans and collectors alike. The magazine from August 2000 captures a moment in time, providing readers with a nostalgic and valuable piece of entertainment history.
